steps.text: Use a Linux server with Docker. Point `{DOMAIN}` and `*.{DOMAIN}` at it.

steps.code:
VERSION=0.8.20
curl -fLO https://github.com/vineetu/simple-host/releases/download/hack-v$VERSION/simple-hack-$VERSION.tar.gz
tar xzf simple-hack-$VERSION.tar.gz
cd simple-hack-$VERSION

after: Sign in to the server admin page at `https://{DOMAIN}/admin` with the key from `sudo grep ADMIN_API_KEY /opt/simple-hack/.env`.
Connect an AI app (ChatGPT, Claude, ...) to `https://{DOMAIN}/mcp` (never the hosted service).
